channel.title: Outside Noise Recommendations
channel.description: Ten experimental, underground, and heavy music discoveries selected from Outside Noise, updated Tuesdays and Thursdays.

item.title: Dis Fig — Arrival
item.description: Crushing experimental electronics moving between cavernous bass, exposed vocals, feedback, and cinematic eruptions. Artist era: Established; solo debut 2019. Recording: 2026. Outside Noise · Bandcamp

item.title: Anagnorisis — Nothing Left to Give
item.description: Emotionally brutal black metal shaped by illness, exhaustion, and grief. Artist era: Older/Archival; formed 2003 and recently returned. Recording: 2026. Outside Noise · Bandcamp

item.title: Grumpy — The Whale feat. D.A. Crimson
item.description: Queer country-rock and distorted indie pop with a crooked outsider quality. Artist era: Established; earliest verified album 2020. Recording: 2026. Outside Noise · Bandcamp · Spotify

item.title: Nicole Sabouné — Ana (أنا)
item.description: Dark art-pop and post-punk combining Swedish coldness with Middle Eastern melodic elements. Artist era: Established; recording career began around 2012. Recording: 2026. Outside Noise

item.title: Fawn Burke — Incense for the Data Center
item.description: Weirdo folktronica with fragile songwriting embedded in degraded digital texture. Artist era: Unknown. Recording: 2026. Outside Noise

item.title: The Blood Mountain Black Metal Choir — Peace in Death
item.description: Communal black metal with choral weight, ritualistic repetition, and rough DIY production. Artist era: New; earliest verified release 2026. Recording: 2026. Outside Noise · Bandcamp

item.title: Wellness — 503
item.description: Gnarly NYC extreme metal with blackened dissonance, mathcore-like rhythmic cuts, and hardcore momentum. Artist era: New; earliest verified release 2026. Recording: 2026. Outside Noise · Bandcamp

item.title: Squee — watching my local wendys burn to the ground outside my low income apartment
item.description: Surfy garage punk bent through internet-era noise, abrupt tonal changes, and damaged humor. Artist era: Unknown. Recording: 2026. Outside Noise · Bandcamp

item.title: Luca Durán — Killing Mariposas feat. Debit
item.description: Acidic club production colliding with cumbia-derived rhythm, industrial texture, and warped sound design. Artist era: Established; releases verified from the late 2010s. Recording: 2026. Outside Noise · Bandcamp

item.title: The Drin — Fatal Charade
item.description: Murky psychedelic post-punk driven by repetitive bass, distant vocals, and a poisoned Western atmosphere. Artist era: Established; earliest verified releases around 2018–2019. Recording: 2026. Outside Noise · Bandcamp
